applicabilityBasis.summary: FPI references CPI purchasing power and redeems through a protocol controller into a variable quantity of legacy FRAX. The opened sources establish neither a fixed national-currency redemption obligation nor bank-dollar redemption, even though FPI was designed as a transaction unit of account.

references.label: Frax FPI CPI reference and controller redemption

genius.notes: Scope assessed from CPI reference and FRAX redemption rather than the algorithmic label. FIP-448 proposes freezing the reference price and retiring minting; completed execution was not established, and redemption into legacy FRAX alone does not establish the statutory fixed monetary-value obligation. No legal issuer authorization is asserted.
